name: Tiszabezdéd (Hungary)
description: White field with a blue horizontal stripe along the top edge and a green stripe along the bottom edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tiszabezdéd (a green shield with a yellow charge, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and yellow mantling) above the name Tiszabezdéd in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tiszabezdéd arms with helm, crest and mantling
